## Overview

This document describes how the Enterprise Architecture Platform's MkDocs documentation platform integrates with the RAG service to provide AI-powered search capabilities. The integration implements an intelligent incremental indexing system that significantly improves deployment performance by processing only changed or new documentation files.
page_texts.3:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/11-mkdocs-integration.md#key-benefits]

### Key Benefits

- **Performance Optimization** - ~87.5% reduction in files processed per deployment (67 out of 538 files)
- **Time Savings** - ~8 minutes saved per deployment
- **Cost Reduction** - ~86% reduction in Bedrock API costs (~$0.43 saved per deployment)
- **Annual Savings** - ~$61.92 (assuming 3 deployments/week)
- **Scalability** - Enables frequent updates without cost barriers

[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/11-mkdocs-integration.md#architecture-overview] ## Architecture Overview The MkDocs integration follows a workflow-driven approach where intelligent file identification happens **external to the RAG service** during the deployment pipeline: ```mermaid flowchart TB subgraph "MkDocs Deployment Workflow" A[MkDocs Build] --> B[Generate Sitemap] B --> C[Kubernetes Job:
identify_files_to_index.py] C --> D[Query OpenSearch State] D --> E[Compare & Filter Files] E --> F[Output files-to-index.json] F --> G[create_rag_content_payload.py] G --> H[Read File Content] end subgraph "RAG Service" I[POST /api/rag/v1/index] J[Chunk Text] K[Generate Embeddings] L[Store in OpenSearch] end H --> I I --> J J --> K K --> L style C fill:#e1f5fe style E fill:#e8f5e8 style I fill:#f3e5f5 ``` **Key Principle**: - **Intelligence** = External deployment workflow (Kubernetes Job + scripts) - **Processing Engine** = RAG service (receives filtered content, processes it)

[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/11-mkdocs-integration.md#overview]

### Overview

The intelligent incremental indexing system compares the current MkDocs sitemap against the OpenSearch index state to determine which files actually need processing. This comparison happens in a Kubernetes Job during the MkDocs deployment workflow.
page_texts.9:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/11-mkdocs-integration.md#1-mkdocs-platform-deployment]

#### 1. MkDocs Platform Deployment

The MkDocs service deploys and generates `sitemap.xml` with all documentation files:

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">
  <url>
    <loc>https://domain.com/LICENSE/</loc>
    <lastmod>2026-02-20T10:30:00Z</lastmod>
  </url>
  <url>
    <loc>https://domain.com/foundation/practice-overview/</loc>
    <lastmod>2026-02-20T09:15:00Z</lastmod>
  </url>
  <!-- ~538 total files -->
</urlset>
```
page_texts.10:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/11-mkdocs-integration.md#2-kubernetes-job-execution]

#### 2. Kubernetes Job Execution

GitHub Actions deploys a Kubernetes Job in the `eapref-app` namespace to perform intelligent file identification:

```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: identify-files-job-${GITHUB_SHA}
  namespace: eapref-app
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: rag-service-account  # IRSA for OpenSearch access
      containers:
      - name: identify-files
        image: python:3.11-slim
        command: ["python3", "/scripts/identify_files_to_index.py"]
        env:
        - name: FORCE_REINDEX
          value: "false"  # Enable intelligent filtering
        - name: TARGET_ENV
          value: "dev"
        - name: OPENSEARCH_URL
          valueFrom:
            configMapKeyRef:
              name: rag-service-config
              key: OPENSEARCH_URL
        - name: OPENSEARCH_INDEX_NAME
          value: "ea-documentation-dev"
        volumeMounts:
        - name: scripts
          mountPath: /scripts
        - name: sitemap
          mountPath: /sitemap
      volumes:
      - name: scripts
        configMap:
          name: processing-scripts
      - name: sitemap
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: mkdocs-sitemap
      restartPolicy: Never
```
page_texts.12:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/11-mkdocs-integration.md#4-output-extraction]

#### 4. Output Extraction

GitHub Actions extracts the filtered file list from job logs:

```bash
# Wait for job completion
kubectl wait --for=condition=complete --timeout=300s \
  job/identify-files-job-${GITHUB_SHA} -n eapref-app

# Extract JSON output from logs
kubectl logs job/identify-files-job-${GITHUB_SHA} -n eapref-app | \
  sed -n '/===BEGIN_FILES_TO_INDEX_JSON===/,/===END_FILES_TO_INDEX_JSON===/p' | \
  grep -v '===' > files-to-index.json
```

**files-to-index.json** output format:

```json
{
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "LICENSE.md",
      "url": "https://domain.com/LICENSE/",
      "size_bytes": 1234,
      "mtime": "2026-02-20T10:30:00Z",
      "reason": "not_indexed"
    },
    {
      "path": "foundation/practice-overview.md",
      "url": "https://domain.com/foundation/practice-overview/",
      "size_bytes": 5678,
      "mtime": "2026-02-20T09:15:00Z",
      "reason": "file_newer"
    }
  ],
  "total_files": 67,
  "sitemap_files": 538,
  "indexed_files": 552,
  "force_reindex": false
}
```
page_texts.13:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/11-mkdocs-integration.md#5-content-payload-creation]

#### 5. Content Payload Creation

The `create_rag_content_payload.py` script processes the filtered file list:

```bash
python3 .github/scripts/processing/create_rag_content_payload.py
# Input: files-to-index.json
# Output: content-payload.json
```

**Processing steps**:

- Reads `files-to-index.json` (67 files identified for indexing)
- Reads actual file content from repository
- Uses shared configuration (`.tooling/components/shared/`) for environment-specific settings
- Creates JSON payload with content and metadata

**content-payload.json** output format:

```json
{
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "LICENSE.md",
      "content": "# License\n\nMIT License...",
      "metadata": {
        "size_bytes": 1234,
        "mtime": "2026-02-20T10:30:00Z"
      }
    }
  ],
  "total_files": 67,
  "environment": "dev"
}
```
page_texts.14:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/11-mkdocs-integration.md#6-api-driven-indexing]

#### 6. API-Driven Indexing

GitHub Actions calls the RAG service `/api/rag/v1/index` endpoint:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://eapref-app.pfe.guidewire.com/api/rag/v1/index" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data @content-payload.json
```
page_texts.15:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/11-mkdocs-integration.md#7-rag-service-processing]

#### 7. RAG Service Processing

The RAG service receives the filtered payload and:

1. **Chunks text content** - Splits documents with context preservation
2. **Generates embeddings** - Uses AWS Bedrock Titan to create vectors
3. **Stores in OpenSearch** - Saves vectors and metadata
4. **Returns statistics** - Provides processing metrics

**Response**:

```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "indexed_files": 67,
  "chunks_created": 342,
  "vectors_stored": 342,
  "processing_time_ms": 12450,
  "timestamp": "2026-02-20T10:32:15Z"
}
```

[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/11-mkdocs-integration.md#identifyfilestoindexpy]

### identify_files_to_index.py

**Location**: `.github/scripts/processing/identify_files_to_index.py`

**Purpose**: Compare sitemap against OpenSearch to determine which files need indexing

**Key Features**:

- **IRSA Authentication**: Uses Kubernetes service account for credential-free OpenSearch access
- **Dual-Path Matching**: Handles both leaf files and directory indexes
- **URL Decoding**: Processes special characters in file paths
- **Smart Filtering**: Identifies files based on not_indexed, file_newer, unchanged_skip criteria

**Environment Variables**:

```bash
FORCE_REINDEX="false"          # Enable/disable intelligent filtering
TARGET_ENV="dev"               # Target environment (dev/prod)
OPENSEARCH_URL="https://..."   # OpenSearch domain URL
OPENSEARCH_INDEX_NAME="ea-documentation-dev"  # Index name
AWS_REGION="us-east-1"         # AWS region for IRSA
```

**Output**: `files-to-index.json` with filtered file list

### create_rag_content_payload.py

**Location**: `.github/scripts/processing/create_rag_content_payload.py`

**Purpose**: Read actual file content and create JSON payload for RAG service

**Key Features**:

- **Content Reading**: Reads actual file content from repository
- **Shared Configuration**: Uses `.tooling/components/shared/` for environment-specific settings
- **File Type Filtering**: Respects content type rules from shared configuration

**Environment Variables**:

```bash
TARGET_ENV="dev"  # Target environment (dev/prod)
```

**Input**: `files-to-index.json` (from identify_files_to_index.py)
**Output**: `content-payload.json` (for RAG service)

[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/11-mkdocs-integration.md#irsa-configuration]

### IRSA Configuration

The Kubernetes Job uses IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts) for credential-free access to OpenSearch:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: rag-service-account
  namespace: eapref-app
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/rag-service-role
```

**Required IAM Permissions**:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "es:ESHttpPost",
        "es:ESHttpGet"
      ],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:es:us-east-1:ACCOUNT:domain/opensearch-domain/*"
    }
  ]
}
```

[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/11-mkdocs-integration.md#kubernetes-job-issues]

### Kubernetes Job Issues

**View Job Logs**:

```bash
# Real-time logs
kubectl logs -f job/identify-files-job-${GITHUB_SHA} -n eapref-app

# Historical logs
kubectl logs job/identify-files-job-${GITHUB_SHA} -n eapref-app

# Job status
kubectl get jobs -n eapref-app

# Job events
kubectl describe job/identify-files-job-${GITHUB_SHA} -n eapref-app
```

**Common Issues**:

1. **IRSA Authentication Failure**:

   ```
   Error: AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform: es:ESHttpPost
   ```

   - **Solution**: Verify `rag-service-account` has correct IAM role annotation
   - Check IAM role trust policy allows EKS service account

2. **OpenSearch Connectivity**:

   ```
   Error: Connection timeout to OpenSearch
   ```

   - **Solution**: Ensure VPC networking allows EKS to OpenSearch communication
   - Verify security group rules
   - Check OpenSearch domain is in same VPC as EKS cluster

3. **Path Matching Failures**:

   ```
   Warning: File not found: LICENSE/README.md
   ```

   - **Solution**: Script includes dual-path matching and URL decoding
   - Verify file exists in OpenSearch with correct path
   - Check for URL-encoded characters
page_texts.29:
[.tooling/components/apis/rag-service/docs/11-mkdocs-integration.md#integration-issues]

### Integration Issues

**Files Not Identified**:

- Check sitemap contains expected files
- Verify OpenSearch query returns indexed files
- Confirm `indexed_at` timestamps are accurate

**Files Over-Identified**:

- Check `lastmod` timestamps in sitemap
- Verify OpenSearch `indexed_at` field exists
- Consider file touch operations that update mtime without content changes

**Job Hangs or Times Out**:

- Check OpenSearch domain is accessible
- Verify job has sufficient resources (memory, CPU)
- Review logs for Python errors or stack traces

### Force Reindex

If intelligent filtering produces unexpected results, bypass it:

```yaml
# In GitHub Actions workflow or manual Job
- name: FORCE_REINDEX
  value: "true"
```

This will index all files regardless of their status in OpenSearch.
